messages.author: d17eed8c529753ab
messages.subject: Error drawing graphs.
parts:
I keep getting this error for my plots

object 'graphdatahist' not found
object 'graphdatapie' not found

But when I run those code fragments from R, they render properly as I want them to.

My server.R:

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

anc_data <- read.csv("anc_indicator.csv",header = TRUE)

# Define server logic required to generate and plot a random distribution
shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
 
  # Expression that generates a plot of the distribution. The expression
  # is wrapped in a call to renderPlot to indicate that:
  #
  #  1) It is "reactive" and therefore should be automatically
  #     re-executed when inputs change
  #  2) Its output type is a plot
  #
  output$piePlot <- renderPlot({
   
    # generate pie chart for Totals for the grouping of each indicator
    indicatorTotals<-tapply(anc_data$Total,anc_data$Indicator,sum)
    graphdatapie <- as.data.frame(indicatorTotals)
    c <- ggplot(graphdatapie, aes(x=rownames(graphdatapie),y=Totals,fill = Totals)) + geom_bar(width = 1,stat="identity")
    print(c + coord_polar(theta = "y"))
  })
  output$histPlot <- renderPlot({
   
    # generate pie chart for Totals for the grouping of each indicator
    indicatorTotals <- tapply(anc_data$Total,anc_data$Indicator,sum)
    graphdatahist <- as.data.frame(indicatorTotals)
    c <- ggplot(graphdatahist, aes(x=rownames(graphdatahist),y=Totals,fill = Totals))
    print(c + geom_bar(width = 1,stat="identity")+ xlab("Indicators"))
  })
  output$timeSeriesPlot <- renderPlot({
   
    # generate time series graph for each indicator for all periods
    interaction.plot(anc_data$Period,anc_data$Indicator,anc_data$Total,legend=TRUE,xlab="Time",ylab="Total Visits",col=rainbow(length(anc_data$Indicator)),trace.label="Indicators")
  })
})

My ui.R

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
# Define UI for application that plots random distributions
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Sample Plots"),
 
  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of observations
  sidebarPanel(
    plotOutput("histPlot")
    #sliderInput("obs","Number of observations:", min = 0, max = 1000, value = 500)
  ),
 
  # Show a plot of the generated distribution
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("timeSeriesPlot"),
    plotOutput("piePlot")
  )
))

What could be causing those errors? i'm a newbie BTW.

messages.subject: Re: Error drawing graphs.
parts: Figured it out. Just include "environment=environment()" in the ggplot. :-)
